generate_gmock_classes: run gmock_class.py on a C++ header file to generate Google Mock classes for all classes
generate_gmock_for_class: run gmock_class.py on a header file with a specific class name to generate a mock for that class
generate_mock_methods: call _GenerateMethods to produce MOCK_METHOD macros for virtual functions in a parsed C++ class AST node
generate_mock_classes: call _GenerateMocks to produce full mock class definitions from a C++ AST including namespaces and templates
parse_and_generate: use ast.BuilderFromSource to parse a C++ header then pass the AST to _GenerateMocks for mock generation
